title: Let a fresh advisor consult open the high-risk execution gate
action: Replace set_gate.rs's two unconditional high-risk refusal arms (the silent-peek arm and the post-lock race arm, both currently calling high_risk_execution_gate_refusal) with the real precondition ported from requireFreshAdvisorForHighRisk (`git show b066880d:packages/bee/bee.mjs`, line 3285). The rule: when the target record's mode is high-risk and an execution component is being APPROVED, compute the staleness verdict of the record's advisor_ref; if stale, refuse with a message naming every staleness reason and the exact remedy command (`bee state advisor-ref record --advisor "<identity>" --digest-file <path>`, plus ` --lane <feature>` when the target is a lane); if fresh, ALLOW the approval to proceed. Keep both arms consistent with each other and keep the refusal fail-closed -- any error computing staleness refuses rather than approves. Nothing is written on the refusal path.

truths: A high-risk execution approval SUCCEEDS when a fresh advisor_ref is present -- this is the whole point of the cell
It still refuses when the ref is missing or stale, naming which anchor moved
A non-high-risk record's gate behaviour is byte-for-byte unchanged
artifacts: A test approving a high-risk merged gate after recording a fresh ref, and a test for each refusal cause
A test proving the unapprove path (--approved false) is unaffected
prohibitions: Do not weaken the refusal into a warning
Do not let an error computing staleness read as fresh

verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml; then live: record a consult on lane advisor-gate-port and confirm `bee state gate --lane advisor-gate-port --merge --approved true` now succeeds, and that it refuses again once a new decision is logged.
